verdict.rationale: BigQuery provides multiple fully-managed ingestion paths for continuously arriving data: the Storage Write API with exactly-once semantics for streaming writes, a native Pub/Sub-to-BigQuery subscription for high-throughput event streaming, Continuous Queries for real-time analysis of incoming data, and scheduled or near-real-time database replication load jobs, all without the user provisioning or operating pipeline infrastructure. Docs explicitly market BigQuery as having no infrastructure to set up or manage. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence validating continuous streaming ingestion at scale, and more detail on CDC or file-arrival-triggered ingestion beyond Pub/Sub and replication mentions.
